arabic text: Baba ye musalman, muje rone nahi dete
english translation text: Baba, these Muslims do not allow me to weep

arabic text: Matam tere zindaan me hone nahi dete\nBaba ye musalman, muje rone nahi dete
english translation text: They do not allow mourning for you to take place in the prison\nBaba, these Muslims do not allow me to weep

arabic text: Bistar tera sinaa, tha jise chin-e liyaa hai) Ab god-e me madar ke ye\nsone nahi dete\nBaba ye musalman, muje rone nahi dete
english translation text: Your chest was my bedding, but it has been taken from me Now even in my\nmother's lap, they do not allow me to sleep\nBaba, these Muslims do not allow me to weep

arabic text: Ehsaas-e yatimi, muje zindan me huwa hai Ab khak-e me soti hu to\nsone nahi dete\nBaba ye musalman, muje rone nahi dete
english translation text: I understood orphanhood within the prison Now when I sleep upon\nthe dust, they do not even let me rest\nBaba, these Muslims do not allow me to weep

arabic text: Thak jaate hai sajjad-e to baba tera katil Bimaar-e mere bhayi ko sone\nnahi dete\nBaba ye musalman, muje rone nahi dete
english translation text: Whenever Sajjad grows exhausted, Baba, your killer does not allow my\nailing brother to sleep\nBaba, these Muslims do not allow me to weep

arabic text: Marja ungi zindaa ke andhere me sisakar Ek kirne ujaale ki ye hone\nnahi dete\nBaba ye musalman, muje rone nahi dete
english translation text: I will die sobbing in the darkness of the prison They do not allow even\na single ray of light to appear\nBaba, these Muslims do not allow me to weep

arabic text: Gash-e ate hai sajjad-e ko pawo me he chale Zanjir-e juda tan se ye\nhone nahi dete\nBaba ye musalman, muje rone nahi dete
english translation text: Sajjad faints, and his feet are covered in blisters They do not allow the\nchains to be separated from his body\nBaba, these Muslims do not allow me to weep
